instruction: I booked a few hotel rooms today for my upcoming trip. How much did I spend in total from my Discover card based on the email confirmations?
notes: The task is a question answered by reading hotel booking confirmation emails received today; the amounts and the payment card used are in the receipt attachments, so each attachment must be downloaded (gmail.download_attachment, which needs a file_system token) and read with file_system.show_file. 'A few' bookings is modeled as three booking threads, each with one receipt attachment and one downloaded file path; the executor loops over however many booking threads the inbox search actually returns. gmail.show_inbox_threads is filtered with query 'hotel' and min_created_at = start of today; its effect (booking-threads-found) stands for the thread ids being known. The answer object discover-total is a runtime value: the sum of the receipt amounts whose card is Discover (receipts paid with other cards are excluded at runtime). The static fact (total-of discover-total f1 f2 f3) ties the answer to the receipts, so supervisor-complete-task requires every receipt to have been read, mirroring the goal. No records are created/updated apart from attachment download counts and new downloaded files, matching the evaluation.
